siteSettings.title: Rate Card & Company Profile | Venturo
siteSettings.description: Pelajari layanan software development dan portofolio kami dengan mudah. Company Profile Venturo versi PDF tersedia di sini.
siteSettings.customCodeBodyEnd:
<script>
  // Ambil bagian path dari URL (tanpa domain)
  var path = window.location.pathname.toLowerCase();

  // Cek domain dan path
  var host = window.location.hostname.toLowerCase();
  var isVenturo =
    host === "venturo.id" || host === "www.venturo.id";
  var isLowongan = path === "/lowongan.id";

  if (isVenturo && isLowongan) {
    // Redirect ke /job di domain yang sama
    window.location.replace("/job");
  }
</script>
